  let(:test_request) { Class.new }

# good
module M
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern
  included do
    const_set(:LIST, [])
  end
end

# `enums` for Typed Enums via `T::Enum` in Sorbet.

  enums do
    Foo = new("foo")
